items.title: Add StoryReadinessReport model and read-only lifecycle_check command
items.context: Implement the V1 command surface from docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-execution-plan.md. The command must read current story phase, git hashes, validation, delivery, reviewer, summary, and done_prepare-adjacent readiness facts and render text/json without writes.
items.userSees: `lattice lifecycle_check --storyId=B-xxxx --target=DONE --json` prints a StoryReadinessReport JSON object with storyId, target, phase, mode, readiness, next, and claims.localReady.

happy.desc: lifecycle_check command exists, is registered as readOnly, and returns StoryReadinessReport JSON for a real story

edge.desc: format=json and --json produce the same top-level report shape without changing story files

adversarial.desc: runCommands:true or writeEvidence:true fail closed and do not run child commands or write metadata

verificationEvidence.note: CLI returns StoryReadinessReport JSON with storyId/target/phase/mode/readiness/next/claims.localReady for a real story.
Smoke verifies JSON/text report shape and story metadata snapshot remains unchanged after lifecycle_check.
Smoke uses a throwing store to prove runCommands:true/writeEvidence:true fail before reading store facts or writing metadata.

items.title: Classify readiness rows using blocking semantics and exact next actions
items.context: localReady must be true iff no readiness row has blocking:true. Advisory/warn/manual/external rows remain visible. Missing/stale/blocking rows must include owner, category, source, and next action where available.
items.userSees: Terminal shows `localReady: false`, `code: missing_delivery_check`, `category: missing`, `owner: delivery-reviewer`, and `next: run delivery_check_set` while advisory rows remain non-blocking.

happy.desc: localReady is true iff no readiness row has blocking:true

edge.desc: warn/advisory rows are visible and do not block localReady

adversarial.desc: manual/external/Authority claims are not promoted to authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone without verified receipt facts

verificationEvidence.note: Text output shows WARN advisory rows while localReady remains controlled only by blocking rows.
Smoke asserts authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone are false in V1 without verified Authority receipt facts.

items.title: Cover lifecycle_check with smoke tests and validation
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage for JSON report shape, localReady blocking semantics, missing delivery/summary/done-required rows, and no-mutation behavior. Wire the smoke into existing validation if appropriate.
items.userSees: `lattice lifecycle_check --storyId=<story> --target=DONE` prints stable readiness rows, exact next actions, and a no-mutation V1 mode line; the smoke proves story files are unchanged before/after.

happy.desc: smoke test verifies JSON report shape and text output for lifecycle_check

edge.desc: smoke test covers missing delivery/summary/DONE-required rows as distinct blockers with next actions

adversarial.desc: smoke test snapshots story metadata before/after lifecycle_check and fails if any mutation occurs
